The project debuted at No. 1 on the Billboard 200 with 613,000 equivalent album units in its first week, giving Drake his 10th No. 1 album on the chart. It also opened with more than 744 million on-demand streams in the U. S.

source_caption_text:
Never forget when Druski tried to sign Drake 😭😂😂

Druski really tried to sign Drake to Coulda Been Records back in 2021 😭😂 The hilarious moment came shortly after Drake released Certified Lover Boy, one of the biggest albums of his career. The project debuted at No. 1 on the Billboard 200 with 613,000 equivalent album units in its first week, giving Drake his 10th No. 1 album on the chart. It also opened with more than 744 million on-demand streams in the U.S., making it one of the biggest streaming debuts ever at the time.

With Drake fresh off a massive album release, Druski’s pitch to bring him over to Coulda Been Records made the exchange even funnier. The label may not have landed one of rap’s biggest superstars, but the clip gave fans a classic moment to look back on. Would Drake have fit the Coulda Been Records roster?
